protocol.name: eclipse_protected_surface_v1
protocol.copyright: Copyright EclipseOS contributors. Apache-2.0 (F-05 section 3, 4): clients and toolkit bridges link the client side under any licence.
protocol.description:
A client marks one of its own wl_surfaces, and with it every subsurface and popup below it, as protected: only physical human input reaches it, it is never captured, and it is invisible to agents. Marking only restricts, so any client may do it, and it can name only its own surfaces.
A protected surface may host one commit slot: a card the compositor draws inside it, with a draft the compositor holds, that the human commits with Enter or a click. The client positions the slot and keeps its rectangle empty; it never sees the preview and cannot submit.
Published on the public socket only; the agent socket never holds it. Protection is not trust: the surface's pixels are still the client's.

enum.name: error
enum.description: Codes are shared by every interface of this protocol so a client sees one numbering (COMP-19 section 2).

entry.name: already_protected
entry.summary: the wl_surface already has a protected surface object

entry.name: slot_exists
entry.summary: the protected surface already has a commit slot, or the client its limit of slots

entry.name: not_owner
entry.summary: the wl_surface belongs to another client

entry.name: bad_kind
entry.summary: unknown slot kind, or a request that does not fit the slot's kind

request.name: protect
request.description: One per wl_surface; a second call while the first object lives is protocol error already_protected. The surface must belong to the calling client (not_owner).

interface.name: eclipse_protected_surface_v1
interface.description: While this object lives the surface, its subsurfaces and its popups take physical input only, and are never captured or shown to agents. Protection starts at once and ends at the surface's first commit after destroy.

entry.name: slot_exists
entry.summary: one slot per protected surface, four per client

entry.name: bad_kind
entry.summary: kind is neither task_commit nor task_unpause

entry.name: task_commit
entry.summary: dispatch a task, or resume a session

request.name: get_slot
request.description: x and y are the surface-local logical position of the slot's top left. One slot per protected surface (slot_exists); no other kinds at v1 (bad_kind).

request.name: destroy
request.description: Protection ends at the surface's next commit. Any slot is cancelled.

event.name: input_refused
event.description: Coalesced, at most once a second: input that was not physical and was aimed at this surface was dropped. Carries no origin detail.

interface.name: eclipse_commit_slot_v1
interface.description: The compositor draws the card, holds the draft, previews it and, when the human commits, sends it on. The client receives no preview content.

entry.name: bad_kind
entry.summary: set_draft on a task_unpause slot, or set_unpause on a task_commit slot

entry.name: bad_account
entry.summary: set_account with a name outside the account rule

request.name: set_draft
request.description: narrowing is a CBOR scope list and may only shrink. continuation and resumes are a task id or empty, at most one non-empty. Replaces the draft and disarms. Limited to ten a second; the latest draft wins. Only on a task_commit slot (bad_kind).

request.name: move
request.description: Surface-local logical position of the slot's top left.

request.name: set_account

description.summary: name the account the task runs under

request.description: The owner's account the task's inference runs under (ADR 0077): empty for the default account, or 1 to 32 of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. It is part of the draft: it survives set_draft, is shown on the card, and a change re-previews and disarms like set_draft, under the same rate limit. Only on a task_commit slot (bad_kind); a name outside the rule is bad_account.

event.name: geometry
event.description: Chosen by the compositor, surface-local logical pixels. The client keeps this rectangle free of its own content. Re-sent if the preview's size changes.
